reason: The user (authenticated via name+zip) asked for details of their own three orders to identify which contains the home office items. Providing order information for an authenticated user's own orders is explicitly within policy scope ('provide the user with information about order... e.g. help the user look up order id'). Fetching one order's details via get_order_details is a read-only lookup, not a database-updating action, so no confirmation is required. This is the first of the three orders that would need to be checked.
policy_references: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
provide information about their own profile, orders, and related products
